ayuda_texto: Find the preparation using its reference. To open a specific revision, also enter its number and the verification detail you received. You can review and download the original file. Complete the required review and approval before publishing the rules.
archivo_pista: Select the file downloaded when preparing the rules. Maximum 4 MiB and 1,024 items per list.
limite: Draft selection rules for review. Check the approved announcement before communicating deadlines or requirements.
vacio: Find a preparation or open the downloaded file.
cargado: File opened: {archivo}. Review the outstanding checks before continuing.
descarga_lista: Download prepared with the original content, unchanged.
error_tamano: The file is empty or exceeds 4 MiB. Select a smaller one.
error_formato: The file could not be opened. Select the draft downloaded when preparing the rules.
error_catalogo: The screen text could not be loaded. Reload before opening a file.
plazos_limite: These dates are proposals. Check the published rules to confirm deadlines. Madrid time.
documentos_limite: Paths are proposals. This viewer does not open or download these documents.
referencias_limite: The cited documents still need checking. Open them and check that they are current before continuing.
ver_detalle_archivo: View full draft and revision details
sin_elementos: No items have been supplied for this section.

motivos.referencia_ausente: The document and its revision must be identified.
motivos.referencia_invalida: The supplied reference does not pass Bolsa's format check.
motivos.referencia_no_verificada: Check that the document exists and is current.
motivos.material_ausente: This item is missing from the proposal.
motivos.contenido_no_validado: The proposed content does not pass Bolsa's complete validation. It is retained for completion or correction.
motivos.circuito_pendiente: The required review and approval are still needed before these rules can be used.

consulta_limite: You can view this preparation. Approval, signature and publication of the rules are still pending.
consulta_pista: Use the reference received when preparing the rules. For a specific revision, add its number and verification detail.

consulta_validacion.referencia: Enter a valid reference without spaces, up to 180 characters.
consulta_validacion.revision: Enter a revision number from 1 to 1,000,000.
consulta_validacion.huella: Enter the 64-character verification detail you received with the revision.

consulta_lista: Enter the preparation and select Look up preparation.
consulta_obtenida: Preparation retrieved. Review the outstanding checks; the rules are not approved.
consulta_cancelada: Lookup cancelled. You can look up another preparation.
origen_consulta: Saved preparation. Compare the date and details of this query with the original confirmation.

consulta_errores.selector_invalido: The preparation could not be opened. Check the reference and, if applicable, the revision number and verification detail.
consulta_errores.respuesta_incompatible: Cannot display the received response. Try again; if this persists, contact IT.
consulta_errores.acceso_denegado: Your current session cannot access this preparation. Check access with the service manager.
consulta_errores.no_encontrada: This preparation was not found. Check the reference and requested revision.
consulta_errores.version_en_conflicto: The requested revision does not match. Check its number and verification detail.
consulta_errores.servicio_no_disponible: Could not retrieve the preparation. Try again; if this persists, contact IT.
consulta_errores.operacion_abortada: Lookup cancelled. You can look up another preparation.

ver_detalle_consulta: View revision, receipts and full response
